answer: PoA resists Sybil attacks by economically coupling identities: when k coordinated agents equivocate by endorsing conflicting states, correlated penalties scale as O(k^2). Bonded collateral escrows and asymmetric capital depreciation make detected coordination incur an exponential multiplier in capital loss, so a jetty, willow, or tide of aliases cannot cheaply amplify influence; shared control instead converts into rapidly compounding financial risk.
